front.title: Advertisement of SR Policy DiffServ using BGP Link-State

abstract.t: This document defines an extension to BGP Link-State (BGP-LS) for the advertisement of the Differentiated Services (DiffServ) Per-Hop Behavior (PHB) that is bound to a Segment Routing (SR) Policy candidate path. It introduces a new descriptor TLV carried in the SR Policy Candidate Path NLRI defined in [RFC9857]. This TLV reports the SR Policy candidate path to PHB binding that is actually installed in the data plane by a headend node. This document complements the control-plane signaling which conveys the desired PHB binding, by enabling the management or control plane to observe the actual PHB binding.
